next_design_obligations: Preserve exact serialization and output hashes where scientific identity depends on bytes.
Replace terminal publication with exclusive reservation and never replace a competing result.
Preserve path confinement, regular-file checks, maximum sizes and source hash checks.
Define crash recovery for reserved temporary and terminal files.
Bind Gurobi version, binary identity, license expectation and dataset root reconstruction without redistributing restricted assets.
prohibited_claims: The nine historical publishers are concurrency-safe.
A successful local run proves clean-clone publication safety.
The repository supplies Gurobi or its license.
The hidden-score consumer independently proves model-path confinement.
decision.publisher_contract_gap: All nine can replace an existing terminal result or race after an existence precheck; none proves exclusive result ownership.
decision.solver_contract_gap: The wrapper is pinned and bounded, but the binary/license is external and one consumer lacks a local path-containment check.
